# mtncloud_identity_source (Data Source)

Looks up one identity source by ID or by name, including one made in the console. Identity sources let users log in through your Active Directory or a SAML provider. Their credentials are never read. A name must match exactly one identity source.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# By name (matched exactly); `id = 123` works too.
data "mtncloud_identity_source" "example" {
  name = "Corporate AD"
}

output "identity_source_type" {
  value = data.mtncloud_identity_source.example.type
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (Number) ID of the identity source. Give this or `name`.
- `name` (String) Name of the identity source, matched exactly. Give this or `id`.

### Read-Only

- `active` (Boolean) Whether it is active.
- `code` (String) Code.
- `default_role` (String) Role given to users no mapping applies to.
- `description` (String) Description, or empty.
- `external_login` (Boolean) Whether users log in on the provider's page.
- `login_url` (String) Login URL, or empty.
- `subdomain` (String) Tenant subdomain users log in with.
- `type` (String) Type, for example `activeDirectory` or `saml`.
